decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 006 (dated 11/02/2014)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 4 - No windows shall be inserted in the north western or south eastern elevations without the prior written permission of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The proposed property must only be used as two self contained flats (two at ground floor level and one at first floor and in the roofspace) and for no other use.  No alterations shall be made to the internal layout including the subdivision of any rooms and the addition of any kitchens without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Use as three self contained flats, removal of unathorised ground floor extension, alterations to the main roof and retention of first and second floor extension
